classificationScope: Serialization-class Test BRs in manual-search queue only
candidateMethod: Serialization-topic phrase overlap between Test BR title and AI statement/expected_behavior/constraint_text, restricted to the same declared segment where numeric and prioritized by the ATL105 source-section PDF page range; up to three same-section and two same-segment hints per Test BR.
limitations: Lexical hints are triage only and are not official crosswalk candidate pairs.
Same vocabulary, same segment, or source page does not prove equivalent scope or business behavior.
No AI_ONLY or MISSING conclusion is permitted when no lexical hint is found.
Each Test BR still requires full-corpus source/context review and an authorized append-only decision.
